content: Digital gift card table stakes (BHN/NAPCO 2025 benchmark, 100 programs): unique redeemable code, fixed denomination, email delivery (avg 22 min), mobile-friendly recipient experience, balance check, branded design/templates, expiration date enforcement, issuer dashboard with status tracking (issued/redeemed/expired/cancelled). SMS delivery is now near-table-stakes (9/10 top programs use it). Personalization (sender name, custom message) universally expected.
